info.title: Agent Firewall — input/output safety for AI agents
info.description: Treat every external input as hostile. Match ingested content against known prompt-injection and jailbreak patterns, vet URLs and IPs, check pwned passwords (k-anonymity), and scan for leaked secrets/PII before you log or send. Deterministic, no LLM. Free data: HIBP, RDAP, Tor, Team Cymru, DNS + curated rulesets. The content scan is a pattern matcher, not a classifier: 11 regex rules for known injection and jailbreak phrasings plus 5 obfuscation checks (zero-width characters, bidi overrides, the Unicode tag block, CSS-hidden text, HTML-comment instructions). It reports which rule IDs fired. It will not catch a novel phrasing, a paraphrase or a non-English payload, and it is not a reason to consider untrusted text safe to feed to a model.
